TABLE.NAME: local_quizportal_slotmeta
TABLE.COMMENT: TOEIC facts about one quiz slot that core has nowhere to keep. Chiefly where in the single Listening recording a question begins: the whole of Part 1-4 is one audio file, so every question needs its own offset. Also carries the Part number and the shared-stimulus code, so the exam and review pages can group slots without re-deriving the structure from tags.

FIELD.NAME: slot
FIELD.COMMENT: Slot number within the quiz, matching quiz_slots.slot.

FIELD.NAME: questionnumber
FIELD.COMMENT: Printed question number. Null for a shared-stimulus block, which occupies a slot but is not a numbered question.

FIELD.NAME: audiostart
FIELD.COMMENT: Seconds into the Listening recording where this question begins. Null when the workbook left the mark blank, which is allowed: marks are often filled in after the questions.

FIELD.NAME: passagecode
FIELD.COMMENT: Code of the shared stimulus this slot belongs to, as written on the passages sheet. Null for a standalone question.

TABLE.NAME: local_quizportal_attemptstate
TABLE.COMMENT: Where a candidate stands in the two halves of a TOEIC attempt. Core tracks one attempt as a set of pages; the exam page needs to know when the Listening recording started (it plays on the wall clock, so a reload resumes where the recording now is rather than replaying it), when Listening closed for good, and whether Reading has been opened.

FIELD.NAME: quizid
FIELD.COMMENT: Foreign key references quiz.id. Kept so rows can be swept by quiz: deleting a preview attempt fires no event.

FIELD.NAME: listenstart
FIELD.COMMENT: When the recording started playing. Null until the candidate presses start.

FIELD.NAME: listenduration
FIELD.COMMENT: Length of the recording in seconds, as the browser measured it when playback started.

FIELD.NAME: listenend
FIELD.COMMENT: When Listening closed. From then on Part 1-4 answers are frozen.

FIELD.NAME: readingstart
FIELD.COMMENT: When the candidate left the bridge page and opened Reading.
